scope.control_scope: Seven public/developer/synthetic controls plus one previously seen private audio excerpt; no private source filename or transcript disclosed.

attribution.authors: Suyuan Liu and Molly Babel, University of British Columbia

scoring.primary_chinese: CER after NFKC, lowercase, and removal of Unicode punctuation/separators/whitespace; no numeric or Traditional/Simplified folding.
scoring.primary_english: WER after NFKC, lowercase, Unicode punctuation replaced by spaces, and whitespace tokenization.
scoring.secondary_chinese: Existing digit-equivalent CER maps 0-9 and the alternative spoken digit one; it never replaces primary CER.
scoring.substitutions_deletions_insertions: Minimum edit distance; deterministic tie order diagonal, deletion, insertion; S+D+I is asserted equal to canonical distance.

dataset_provenance.selection_rule: Exclude all 14 prior participants; stable metadata order, four English-onset-after-age-six speakers and four unused Mandarin speakers with region metadata. One complete continuous 18-45 second answer each; no audio-quality, RMS or model-output selection.
dataset_provenance.replacement_note: M98A had no eligible complete 18-45 second answer. Its missing record and full audit were kept; F03A was separately frozen as the next unused metadata row before reading its annotation. All intervals were frozen before downloading their source audio.

strict_spelling_caveat.note: For native 0.6B, strict errors are only Arabic/Chinese numeral style. Both official 0.6B and 1.7B add Traditional/Simplified character variants and have identical output on this case. All preserve the opening hours and words; do not call these semantic misrecognitions.

historical_six_reproduction.note: Six previously seen inputs were reproduced byte-for-byte at the older 512/128 limits. This is separate from the current 2048/512 batch; these older outputs are not selected or mixed into current scores.

sherpa_engine_output_processing.behavior: The fixed engine can trim a low-diversity 64-token tail and stop decoding. Returned IDs also omit the recognized task/language prefix and text applies UTF-8 cleanup. Scoring uses the exact engine-returned text, not a claimed raw generation trace.

limitations: Four new speakers per language are a small holdout, not a general accuracy estimate. Language/region metadata is not an independent acoustic accent-strength rating.
Prior 15 MELI cases are development/regression samples. Their scores do not replace the new-speaker holdout scores.
MELI references start from Whisper-large-v3 drafts corrected by bilingual research assistants; they are not from-scratch independent gold and may favor model-family wording.
MELI ordinary punctuation accuracy is N/A. Chinese CER and English WER are never pooled into one score.
Default Chinese negative controls use VAD, while direct Qwen runs do not. False positives compare whole systems, not solely acoustic models.
Native ONNX INT8 and official BF16 runs differ in runtime and decoder implementation; differences cannot be attributed solely to quantization.

For official Hugging Face, raw tokenizer-decoded text is primary and processed text is diagnostic only. Sherpa native/WASM use exact engine-returned text after built-in processing, including its low-diversity tail guard. No reference-guided replacement is added, and known truncated outputs are retained.
No fine-tuning or weight training occurred. Native CPU success is not browser/mobile deployment validation, download-size suitability, or a phone speed guarantee.
Previously seen private lyrics are a separate control, not a new unseen interview. No source video name, transcript, or token sequence is published here.

web_wasm_validation.scope: Actual official Web WASM and JS API in a browser-shaped Node VM. No native ASR. No browser UI, browser codec, mobile, or network-delivery QA.
web_wasm_validation.output_semantics: Sherpa engine-returned output, after its built-in processing. Not raw decoder logits or a complete generated token trace. Fixed 1.13.8 includes a low-diversity repetition guard that can drop a 64-token tail.

wasm_memory.evidence: Parsed actual WASM section 5 limits and matched runtime JS getHeapMax.

failure.interpretation: Generic runtime abort with a recorded 2 GiB WASM heap. This evidence alone does not establish out-of-memory as the cause.

memory.scope: Maximum of recorded snapshots, not a continuously measured peak; Node process RSS is not browser or phone memory usage.

web_wasm_validation.controls_scope: All eight control outputs were saved before the later abort, so their individual scores are partial diagnostics only. No MELI or full-batch accuracy is reported.
web_wasm_validation.deployment_status: Not ready for release as a browser transcription route: this actual WASM batch failed before completing any MELI case.
limitations: WASM runs one thread; native ONNX uses two. The runtime build git hashes also differ, so neither difference can be isolated as the cause of output changes.
The browser-shaped Node VM executes actual WASM, but it is not browser UI, codec, mobile, or download-delivery testing.
Sherpa returns post-engine text, not a complete generated sequence. Its built-in processing can remove a low-diversity tail, so returned tokens cannot prove absence of truncation.
Default negative controls use VAD; this direct WASM Qwen route does not. The false-positive comparison is at system level.

fresh_same_configuration_diagnostic.interpretation: The same first MELI input succeeded in a fresh process at the same 2048/512 settings. Failure is demonstrated for the sequential batch, not for every isolated 25.62-second input. Process lifetime or workspace use may be relevant; the cause is not established.
fresh_same_configuration_diagnostic.accuracy_evaluation: This one-case execution diagnostic is not substituted into the failed 31-case batch and is not a new accuracy holdout.

derived_capacity_run.scope: Derived resource-stability diagnostic on the same fixed 31 cases after observing a 2048/512 sequential abort. Not independent new holdout data, not browser/mobile UI validation.
derived_capacity_run.change_from_original: Only CLI max_total_len changes 2048 -> 1280. No runner logic, audio, order, references, hotwords, language, model, runtime, max_new_tokens or sampling changes.

completion.full_batch_accuracy_reason: Batch failed; completed-case metrics are partial diagnostics only.

capacity_proof.method: Source-derived conservative upper bound; no feature/model inference performed for this proof. All PCM sample counts read from file sizes.
capacity_proof.feature_upper_bound: F_bound = ceil(PCM_samples / 160) + 100. The 100-frame margin is analytical only; no silence or samples are added. Fixed Qwen uses Whisper-style 10ms frames; aligned GetFrames caps at floor(N/160).
capacity_proof.prompt_assumptions: fixed pinned tokenizer; explicit Chinese or English; no hotwords; <audio_pad> is one token
capacity_proof.minimum_nontruncating_condition: C=A+18 <= M; generation up to G additionally needs C+G-1<=M. We use stricter C+G<=M.
capacity_proof.limitations: Capacity sufficiency is not stability or accuracy evidence. max_new_tokens=512 remains an independent limit. Fixed Sherpa engine output includes low-diversity repetition-tail protection.

derived_capacity_run.output_semantics: Sherpa engine-returned output, after its built-in processing. Not raw decoder logits or a complete generated token trace. Fixed 1.13.8 includes a low-diversity repetition guard that can drop a 64-token tail.
